judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong message names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`) and the wrong interface names (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame` instead of `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationCursor`). It completely omitted the opt-in `HalEngineConfig.transport.history` configuration flag and the `UNSUPPORTED` error code, instead returning an empty array `sessions: []` when `listFor` is missing—which directly violates an explicit requirement and acceptance criterion in the ticket. Furthermore, `validation.ts` allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` (failing the 1–200 bound requirement) and introduces a prototype-pollution hazard via plain object lookup `validators[message.type]`, and `messageHandler.ts` spreads `...summary` (potentially leaking extra properties) and logs `error.message` (which may contain sensitive DB credentials). Finally, `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md` were not updated as required, and a stray `.lore/dod.md` file was committed.
